think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s type and valid range. 2) Check official PostgreSQL documentation for any sentinel/exception values (e.g., -1, 0) that change semantics beyond the normal numeric ordering. 3) Determine whether such values toggle/disable a feature or switch to an alternate mode rather than simply scaling capacity. 4) If a sentinel exists, classify as special and record the value; otherwise classify as not special.
